learning_outcomes.text: Obtain derivation of equations of motion for one degree of freedom systems.
Knows the free and forced vibrations of one degree of freedom systems.
Interpret vibrations of two degree of freedom systems.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: A brief history of vibrations, importance of the study of vibration, basic concepts of vibrations; vibration, elementary parts of vibrations.
CLASSIFICATION OF VIBRATIONS: Free and forced vibrations, undamped and damped vibrations, linear and nonlinear vibrations, deterministic and random vibrations.
VIBRATION ANALYSIS PROCEDURE: Spring element, mass or inertia element, damping element, harmonic motion, harmonic analysis.
FREE VIBRATION OF SINGLE DEGREE OF FREEDOM SYSTEMS: Free vibration of undamped translational system, solution of equation of motion, harmonic motion.
FREE VIBRATIONS WITH DAMPING: Free vibration of damped systems, logarithmic decrement, free vibrations with Coulomb damping.
HARMONICALLY EXCITED VIBRATIONS OF UNDAMPED VIBRATIONS: Equations of motion for an undamped system under harmonic force and their solution, beating.
FORCED VIBRATIONS OF DAMPED VIBRATIONS: Forced vibration of damped systems, response of a system for general periodic forcing, convolution integral.
TWO DEGREE OF FREEDOM SYSTEMS: Equations of motion for two degree of freedom systems and their solution. Torsional systems.
NATURAL FREQUENCIES AND MODE SHAPES: Coordinate coupling and principal coordinates, vibration modes and nodes.
DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER: Dynamic vibration absorbers and their design, dynamic vibration absorbers without damping, dynamic vibration absorbers with damping.
SEMI-DEFINITE SYSTEMS: Vibrations of semi-definite systems, stability, a case study.
NATURAL FREQUENCIES AND MODE SHAPES: Dunkerley’s formula, Rayleigh’s method, fundamental frequencies of beams and shafts.
NATURAL FREQUENCIES AND MODE SHAPES: Holzer’s method, matrix iteration method, Jacobi’s Method, the other methods.
MULTIDEGREE OF FREEDOM SYSTEMS: A general quick view of multidegree of freedom systems, an introduction to matrix methods, some examples of problems.
bibliography: D.J. Inman, Engineering Vibrations, Prentice Hall, 2001.
S.S. Rao, Mechanical Vibrations, 4th edn., Addison-Wesley, 2003.
